body:
Dose: 1mg etizolam ingested orally in the form of Etilaam-1 mouth dissolving tablet.  I have a prescription for .5mg xanax tables for GAD/insomnia, and thought I would test out this benzodiazepene analog to see how it compares.
It is approximately the same as alprazolam (xanax).  It has a bit more of a rapid onset it seems, and the high is more 'out of it' - not exactly drowsy, but it just kinda makes me seem a bit off-kilter.  Walking feels silly, and whereas xanax just makes me tired etizolam makes me simultaneously tired and giggly.
All in all, a decent 'benzo,' but with the documented side effects of increasing prolactin levels (and decreasing libido) as well as causing blepharospasms with repeated use I think I might as well stick with xanax.
